method.name: import_csv
method.description:
Exposed in case users want to automate CSV editing. [param resource_class_name] is the name of the resource class you are editing. [param resource_paths] is a list of all of the path names you wish to import data for. [param path] is the output path for the .csv file.
If paths are in the .csv but not found in [param resource_paths], they will be created, and if paths are in the [param resouce_paths] but are not in the .csv they will be deleted. You can use this then for bulk edits of resources.

method.name: export_csv
method.description: Exposed in case users want to automate CSV editing. [param resource_class_name] is the name of the resource class you are editing. [param resource_paths] is a list of all of the path names you wish to export. [param path] is the output path for the .csv file.

method.name: find_generator_scripts
method.description: Used by the [code]export_resource_tables.gd[/code] script to find resource generator scripts.

method.name: find_or_create_resource
method.description:
This is a utility function for table generator scripts.
Godot doesn't like automation of deleting and re-creating resources, so this is a utility to find or create resource files so you can edit or create them with the same API. The intended use case is to create the generated tables. Be aware that the items lists will need to be cleared or assigned if you are updating them.

method.name: find_resources_of_type
method.description:
This is a utility function for table generator scripts.
It finds all resources of a type and anything that inherits from it. The intended use case is to find resources to assign to generated table items arrays.
If you want to do custom tables you can filter on these results as well.
